configurations.name: dashboard-staging
runtimeArgs: PMB_DASH_STATE_DIR=state/staging uv run streamlit run scripts/dashboard.py --server.headless=true --server.port=8503 --browser.gatherUsageStats=false

configurations.name: vps-dashboard-attach
runtimeArgs: if lsof -i :8505 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'tunnel already up on :8505'; while true; do sleep 3600; done; else echo 'no tunnel; run: ssh -i ~/Downloads/LightsailDefaultKey-eu-west-1.pem -p 2222 -L 8505:127.0.0.1:8505 -N -f ops@108.132.51.116'; exit 1; fi
